items.name: Claude Fable 5
items.why: Anthropic 最強大的模型，在代理式編程（SWE-Bench Pro 80.3%）和軟體除錯方面表現卓越，適用於複雜的遊戲開發任務。
items.why_en: Anthropic's most powerful model, excelling in agentic coding (SWE-Bench Pro 80.3%) and software debugging, suitable for complex game development tasks.

items.name: MiniMax M3
items.why: 首個結合前沿編程能力、1M 上下文和原生多模態（圖像/影片輸入）的開源模型，SWE-Bench Pro 達 59.0%，對遊戲資產生成和程式碼編寫極具潛力。
items.why_en: The first open-weight model combining frontier-tier coding, 1M context, and native multimodality (image/video input), with SWE-Bench Pro at 59.0%, highly promising for game asset generation and coding.

items.name: Cursor SDK
items.why: 將 Cursor 轉變為可程式化代理平台，新增自訂儲存、工具和自動審查流程，顯著增強 IDE 在程式碼開發中的代理能力。
items.why_en: Transforms Cursor into a programmable agent platform with custom stores, tools, and auto-review flows, significantly enhancing IDE agent capabilities for code development.

items.name: Claude Opus 4.8
items.why: 在 Opus 4.7 基礎上改進，工具使用更清晰，指令遵循更一致，適用於需要自主工程工作負載的遊戲開發。
items.why_en: An improvement over Opus 4.7 with cleaner tool use and more consistent instruction following, suitable for game development requiring autonomous engineering workloads.

items.name: GPT-5.5 Instant / Codex CLI Goal Mode
items.why: GPT-5.5 Instant 提升了程式碼生成和對話品質，結合 Codex CLI 的目標模式，使其成為一個能維持上下文、規劃多步驟工作流程的自主代理執行環境。
items.why_en: GPT-5.5 Instant improves code generation and conversational quality, combined with Codex CLI's Goal Mode, it becomes an autonomous agent runtime that maintains context and plans multi-step workflows.
